_how_to_add: Easiest: python3 add_video.py <youtube-url> --pattern Backtracking   (fills in title/channel automatically)
Or add an object to 'videos' by hand. Only 'url' and 'patterns' are required.
patterns: names from content/patterns.json (e.g. 'Sliding Window'). problems: optional LeetCode slugs (e.g. 'two-sum').
chapters: optional list of 'm:ss Label' (or 'h:mm:ss Label') strings — they become clickable timestamps.

videos.title: Backtracking was HARD until I learned it this way | Backtracking tutorial
chapters: 5:15 Summary & How to Spot Backtracking Problems

videos.title: Learning Graphs is easy once you watch this!
videos.notes: Vertices and edges up to BFS, DFS, grids as graphs, topological sort, Dijkstra and minimum spanning trees, and how to tell which one a problem needs.
